description_en: Creates a trademark entity. Scenarios: when the signature source is a trademark, trademark information needs to be uploaded
description_zh: 创建商标实体。使用场景是签名来源=商标时，需要上传商标信息
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-sms-trademark --trademark-pic 123456/test1719383196031.jpg --trademark-registration-number 766905 --trademark-name '阿里云' --trademark-applicant-name '阿里巴巴（中国）有限公司' --trademark-eff-exp-date '2010-12-14~2030-12-13' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmsTrademark

parameters.help_en:
The fileKey of the trademark details screenshot.

How to query a trademark:
Log on to the China Trademark Office website and click "Online Trademark Query" to take a screenshot of the trademark details.
Accept the terms of use and enter the "Application/Registration Number" to query.
Click the "Application/Registration Number" to view the details.

Trademark file information uploaded to OSS. File upload requirements:
The file name must not contain Chinese characters or special characters.
Only images in jpg, png, gif, or jpeg format are supported. The image size must not exceed 5 MB.
The screenshot must contain the complete URL.
The trademark image must be clear and exactly match the "Signature Name".
The "Applicant Name" must exactly match the name of the organization associated with the signature.
The trademark status must be a registered trademark.

Obtain the fileKey as follows: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html
parameters.help_zh:
商标详情截图fileKey。

商标查询方法：
登录中国商标网点击“商标网上查询”商标详情截图。
接受使用说明，填入“申请/注册号”查询。
点击“申请/注册号”查询详情。

上传到OSS的商标文件信息。文件上传要求：
待上传的文件命名不可包含中文和特殊字符。
仅支持jpg、png、gif、jpeg格式的图片，图片不大于5MB。
截图中包含完整的网址;
商标图片清晰，和“签名名称”完全一致；
“申请人名称”需和签名关联的企事业单位名称完全一致；
商标状态为注册商标。

fileKey的获取方式如下：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html
